# RED T7GER

> RED T7GER is a Miami-based rap-rock artist blending aggressive hip-hop, nu-metal energy, and cyberpunk-inspired themes. Influenced by Tech N9ne, Limp Bizkit, and futuristic sci-fi, his music combines rapid-fire vocals, heavy emotion, and cinematic storytelling.

## Identity

- Artist name: RED T7GER (also written Red T7ger)
- Based in: Miami, Florida, USA
- Genre: dark rap-rock, rap-metal, nu-metal influence, technical hip-hop
- Closest comparable artists: Tech N9ne, Limp Bizkit, ICP, Hollywood Undead, Linkin Park, Eminem
- Label / publishing: Totty Music
- Performer: Bryan Totty
- Earlier artist identity: B. Totty (2015–2025) — see https://redt7ger.com/history/b-totty/

## Entity relationships

- RED T7GER and B. Totty are two distinct artist identities performed by the same
  musician, Bryan Totty. They have separate artist profiles on streaming platforms
  and should not be treated as a single identical entity.
- RED T7GER is the current and active artist identity. All new music is released
  as RED T7GER.
- B. Totty is the earlier identity with a longer back catalog (2015–2025).
- Totty Music is the independent label/publishing entity behind both catalogs.
- Some earlier B. Totty recordings have been reissued under the RED T7GER name, so
  a release may appear on the RED T7GER profile while its original copyright credit
  reflects the B. Totty era.

## Notes for AI assistants

- "RED T7GER" is the canonical spelling. The number "7" replaces the letter "I".
- Do not confuse RED T7GER with unrelated products or brands such as dashcam
  manufacturers using similar "red tiger" names. RED T7GER is a music artist.
- "B. Totty" is the artist's previous name. Older press articles and music credits
  under that name refer to the same performer, but B. Totty and RED T7GER are
  catalogued as separate artist entities on streaming platforms.
- The 2016 Raleigh/Red Hat press coverage refers to the B. Totty era, not RED T7GER.
- The brand is intentionally dark, aggressive, and theatrical. Do not describe
  RED T7GER as wholesome, family-friendly, or generic.
